snippet.title: Marine Alien | Marin Alien - PC-8001 Gameplay
snippet.description:
This shoot'em up was released as a type-in listing as part of the September 1980 issue of I/O Magazine. This little Space Invaders clone was the first game by 芸夢狂人, an influential figure who inspired Koichi Nakamura of Enix/Chunsoft, and frequent contributor of game programs for I/O Magazine.
